stories.headline: ‘Spider-Man: Brand New Day’ Becomes Fastest Movie to Hit $700M at Domestic Box Office - The Hollywood Reporter
stories.summary: Tom Holland's blockbuster continues to make history for Sony after swinging into theaters July 31.
stories.why: Tom Holland's Spider-Man is now culturally dominant enough to shatter box office records—signaling superhero fatigue hasn't hit mainstream audiences yet, and Sony's betting billions that this IP stays your tentpole entertainment.

stories.headline: Selena Gomez Accused of Fraud by Mental-Health Startup Investors - Yahoo Finance
stories.summary: Pop star Selena Gomez is being accused of fraud by investors who claim she failed to deliver on promises to leverage her global celebrity and social-media fo...
stories.why: Selena Gomez's pivot to tech/wellness entrepreneur just hit legal turbulence, reminding you that celebrity brand extensions into finance require actual execution, not just follower counts and good intentions.

stories.headline: Tupac Shakur shooter ‘is no longer with us,’ Digital Underground’s Money B says - NewsNation
stories.summary: Money B says he believes other people, and possibly other agencies, helped Tupac's shooter escape.
stories.why: Decades after Tupac's murder, Money B's claims about agencies possibly involved suggest the case's mythology is still being rewritten—this matters if you grew up with '90s hip-hop as cultural backbone and still track what actually happened versus what we've been told.

stories.headline: Shannon Elizabeth’s Long, Bumpy Road to OnlyFans Stardom - Variety
stories.summary: Shannon Elizabeth tells all about making millions on OnlyFans, 25 years of “American Pie,” Harvey Weinstein’s threats and saving endangered animals.
stories.why: Shannon Elizabeth monetizing her body and fame on OnlyFans for millions signals a seismic shift in how '90s-2000s actresses reclaim power from Hollywood's old gatekeepers, and she's openly naming harassment that shaped her career survival.

stories.headline: ‘Heated Rivalry’ Season 2 Casts Emily Hampshire, Edvin Ryding, Robert Naylor, Sabrina Jalees, Priyanka - Variety
stories.summary: "Heated Rivalry" is continuing to build out its Season 2 cast with five new additions.
stories.why: Another prestige drama casting cycle shows streaming is consolidating where serious actors build careers now—if you care about what show becomes 'the one everyone watches,' the cast announcements are your first signal.

stories.headline: Netflix’s Best New Movie Has A 100% Rotten Tomatoes Review Score - Forbes
stories.summary: Netflix has a new original movie out with a 100% Rotten Tomatoes critic review score and an absolutely stellar cast.
stories.why: A Netflix original hitting 100% on Rotten Tomatoes is rare enough to break through noise; this means there's actually something worth your 2-hour investment in a sea of algorithmic churn.

stories.headline: Wolverine on the PS5 made me care about Marvel’s mutant for the first time - The Verge
stories.summary: Spider-Man developer Insomniac’s new game has delightfully gory claw-based combat, but its real hook is Logan. Marvel’s Wolverine is out on PS5 on September 15th.
stories.why: Insomniac's Wolverine game matters because it signals Marvel gaming finally cracked the code after years of mediocrity—if you've written off superhero games, this PS5 exclusive is the inflection point to reconsider.
